focus: Fix the distribution surface that was silently broken: the repo was undiscoverable as a skill source
root_cause: vercel-labs/skills discoverSkills() returns early when a repo root contains SKILL.md, so skills/growth-intel was never discoverable via `npx skills add hypetopher/aicompany`. The marketplace.json declared both skills, but the CLI saw one. The previous cycle's 'skills_installable: 2' claim was wrong.

shipped.change: SKILL.md -> skills/ai-company-loop/SKILL.md; .claude-plugin/marketplace.json now points at ./skills/ai-company-loop and ./skills/growth-intel
verification: `npx skills add hypetopher/aicompany --skill growth-intel -a claude-code -y` -> installed to ./.claude/skills/growth-intel

experiment.hypothesis: Discovery is the binding constraint, not content volume: fixing skill layout doubles the installable surface and unblocks registry indexing.

risks.risk: Social growth channel is a mock: post_tweet would write false publish records into ops_social_posts (the exact table that measures the publish path).
risks.action: Do not enable post_tweet until a real adapter exists. Any 'publish' number from ops_social_posts today is fake.

risks.risk: Content output is unpublishable: 16/21 content bodies in 24h had no link, 6/21 carried internal IDs.
risks.action: Add a publish-readiness gate to write_content (link + no internal IDs) before it enters the queue.

risks.risk: npm channel unavailable: no npm auth on this host, so the most measurable distribution channel (weekly downloads) is blocked.
risks.action: Needs AX: npm login + a scoped package name. Unlocks a metric we can actually read.

risks.risk: skills.sh still shows 0 results for ai-company-loop; registry indexing is now unblocked but not yet observed.
risks.action: Re-check skills.sh/api/search next cycle; indexing is the multiplier on the fix just shipped.

risks.risk: Upstream PR #546 still OPEN and unreviewed; third-party PRs are slow, non-deterministic distribution.
risks.action: Treat GitHub PR distribution as a side channel, not the main plan.

next_experiments: Re-measure skills.sh indexing for hypetopher/aicompany (installs > 0 is the success metric).
Add a write_content publish-readiness gate so drafts carry a link and no internal IDs.
AX decision needed: npm auth so the skill can ship as a package with a downloadable metric.
